# Menus

The menu bar as it appears on Windows and Linux, with default shortcuts. On macOS the shortcuts use ⌘ instead of Ctrl (see [Keyboard shortcuts](shortcuts.md)), the menus live in the system menu bar, and a **Notoir** menu holds About, Settings and Quit.

## File

- New File — `Ctrl+N`
- New Scratchpad — `Ctrl+Alt+N`
- New File from Template…
- New Window — `Ctrl+Shift+N`
- Open File… — `Ctrl+O`
- Open Workspace… — `Ctrl+K Ctrl+O`
- **Open Recent** ›
  - *(recent workspaces)*
  - *(recent files)*
  - **Scratchpads** ›
    - *(kept scratchpads)*
  - Clear Recently Opened
- Save — `Ctrl+S`
- Save As… — `Ctrl+Shift+S`
- Save All — `Ctrl+Alt+S`
- Export as HTML…
- **Auto Save** ›
  - Off
  - After Delay
  - On Focus Change
  - On Window Focus Loss
- Revert File
- Close — `Ctrl+W`
- Close Others
- Close All
- Close Workspace
- Exit — `Ctrl+Q`
